title: App Center SDK import
msg: App Center SDK import. The service behind it retired on 2025-03-31 (Analytics & Diagnostics on 2026-06-30).
fix: Import Firebase instead: Plugin.Firebase.Crashlytics (.NET), com.google.firebase.crashlytics (Android), FirebaseCrashlytics (iOS), @react-native-firebase/crashlytics (React Native).

title: App Center package reference
msg: App Center package still referenced in the build. It ships an SDK whose backend no longer answers.
fix: Swap for the Crashlytics package: Plugin.Firebase.Crashlytics (NuGet), com.google.firebase:firebase-crashlytics + the com.google.firebase.crashlytics Gradle plugin, pod 'FirebaseCrashlytics', or @react-native-firebase/app + /crashlytics.

title: AppCenter.Start / configure
msg: AppCenter.Start() initialises a retired service; no crash from this build will reach a dashboard.
fix: Remove it. Crashlytics starts with FirebaseApp from google-services.json (Android) or FirebaseApp.configure() with GoogleService-Info.plist (iOS).

title: App Center app secret
msg: App Center app secret (GUID) left in source.
fix: Delete it. Firebase identifies the app through google-services.json / GoogleService-Info.plist, not a secret string.

title: Crashes.TrackError
msg: Crashes.TrackError() handled errors now go nowhere.
fix: Crashlytics non-fatal: FirebaseCrashlytics.getInstance().recordException(e) (Android), Crashlytics.crashlytics().record(error:) (iOS), crashlytics().recordError(e) (React Native). Move the properties dictionary to setCustomKey (max 64 key-value pairs, 1 kB each).

title: Analytics.TrackEvent
msg: Analytics.TrackEvent() App Center Analytics support ended on 2026-06-30.
fix: Crashlytics has no event API. For crash context use Crashlytics log() (64kB per session); for product analytics call Google Analytics logEvent().

title: Crashes.GenerateTestCrash
msg: Crashes.GenerateTestCrash() test crash that no longer reports anywhere.
fix: Crashlytics test crash: throw RuntimeException("Test Crash") (Android), fatalError() (iOS), crashlytics().crash() (React Native).

title: AppCenter.SetUserId
fix: Crashlytics: setUserId(id) on the Crashlytics instance.

title: SetEnabled toggle
msg: App Center enable/disable toggle; your opt-out setting no longer controls any collection.
fix: Crashlytics: setCrashlyticsCollectionEnabled(bool), plus firebase_crashlytics_collection_enabled=false in the manifest / FirebaseCrashlyticsCollectionEnabled in Info.plist for opt-in.

title: User-confirmation flow
msg: App Center user-confirmation (consent) flow. Ported naively, Crashlytics sends reports automatically and the consent prompt stops meaning anything.
fix: Turn automatic collection off, then call sendUnsentReports() on consent or deleteUnsentReports() on refusal; checkForUnsentReports() tells you whether to ask.

title: Error attachments
msg: App Center error attachments; Crashlytics has no attachment API.
fix: Put short text in Crashlytics log() (64kB per session) and state in setCustomKey (max 64 pairs, 1 kB each); upload files elsewhere and log the URL.

title: Crash send callbacks
msg: App Center send callbacks; nothing fires them any more.
fix: Crashlytics has no per-report send callback; remove the handler and move any UI to the consent flow.

title: App Center Distribute
msg: App Center Distribute in-app updates; there is no Crashlytics equivalent.
fix: Remove it. Microsoft's retirement page points to TestFlight / App Store and Google Play Console for test and production releases.

title: CodePush
msg: CodePush on the App Center service; that service retired on 2025-03-31.
fix: Crashlytics does not do over-the-air updates. Microsoft published a standalone CodePush server you host yourself; point the client's server URL at it or drop OTA.

title: appcenter-cli in scripts
msg: appcenter-cli call in a script or pipeline; API calls fail since 2025-03-31.
fix: Builds: Azure Pipelines (Microsoft's recommendation). dSYM / mapping upload: the Crashlytics Gradle plugin or the upload-symbols script.

title: AppCenter.LogLevel
fix: Crashlytics debug logging: -FIRDebugEnabled launch argument (iOS) or adb shell setprop log.tag.FirebaseCrashlytics DEBUG (Android).
